svg.title: Base Case: $560,000 Revenue to $126,000 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-service-revenue-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case: $560,000 Revenue to $126,000 Owner Net; subtitle: Four expense deductions reconcile exactly to a 22.5% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per mature operating year. The first bar is recognized service revenue, the next four bars are signed expense movements, and the sixth bar is the closing total, not another movement. Expense allocation is illustrative; revenue, net margin, and owner net match the canonical Base Case.; caption: $560,000 - $210,000 - $140,000 - $60,000 - $24,000 = $126,000; $126,000 / $560,000 = 22.5%. Costs total $434,000. No client award principal enters this bridge.; stages: label: Recognized service revenue; value: Opening total: $560,000 annual service fees; numeric value: 560000.0; detail: Recognize earned bid-desk and teaming-support fees under client service agreements. Exclude government award face value, client purchasing volume, and funds that merely pass through for another party.; label: Direct contract delivery; value: Expense movement: subtract $210,000 annually; numeric value: -210000.0; detail: Allocate aggregate project-based compensation to the three contractor seats covering capture analysis, proposal production, and delivery verification. Remaining contribution after this deduction is $350,000.; label: Full-time personnel; value: Expense movement: subtract $140,000 annually; numeric value: -140000.0; detail: Budget total loaded compensation for two full-time seats at an illustrative $70,000 each. Verify actual hiring costs before adopting this allocation. Remaining contribution after personnel expense is $210,000.; label: Operating infrastructure; value: Expense movement: subtract $60,000 annually; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Allocate $24,000 to software and secure document operations, $18,000 to external legal and accounting services, and $18,000 to insurance, selling, and administration. These outside services do not create dedicated pod seats.; label: Rework and credit losses; value: Expense movement: subtract $24,000 annually; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Model $16,000 of unrecovered delivery rework and $8,000 of recognized client credit-loss expense. These are modeled expenses, not an additional cash reserve or an assumption that every late invoice becomes a loss.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: Closing total: $126,000 at 22.5%; numeric value: 126000.0; detail: Treat this bar as the closing total. Non-direct operating expenses equal $224,000 annually, or approximately $18,666.67 monthly, inside the stated $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range; direct contract delivery remains separately identified.

text.title: Base Case: $560,000 Revenue to $126,000 Owner Net
text.tspan: Base Case: $560,000 Revenue to $126,000 Owner Net

circle.title: label: Recognized service revenue; value: Opening total: $560,000 annual service fees; numeric value: 560000.0; detail: Recognize earned bid-desk and teaming-support fees under client service agreements. Exclude government award face value, client purchasing volume, and funds that merely pass through for another party.

label: Direct contract delivery; value: Expense movement: subtract $210,000 annually; numeric value: -210000.0; detail: Allocate aggregate project-based compensation to the three contractor seats covering capture analysis, proposal production, and delivery verification. Remaining contribution after this deduction is $350,000.

label: Full-time personnel; value: Expense movement: subtract $140,000 annually; numeric value: -140000.0; detail: Budget total loaded compensation for two full-time seats at an illustrative $70,000 each. Verify actual hiring costs before adopting this allocation. Remaining contribution after personnel expense is $210,000.

label: Operating infrastructure; value: Expense movement: subtract $60,000 annually; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Allocate $24,000 to software and secure document operations, $18,000 to external legal and accounting services, and $18,000 to insurance, selling, and administration. These outside services do not create dedicated pod seats.

label: Rework and credit losses; value: Expense movement: subtract $24,000 annually; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Model $16,000 of unrecovered delivery rework and $8,000 of recognized client credit-loss expense. These are modeled expenses, not an additional cash reserve or an assumption that every late invoice becomes a loss.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: Closing total: $126,000 at 22.5%; numeric value: 126000.0; detail: Treat this bar as the closing total. Non-direct operating expenses equal $224,000 annually, or approximately $18,666.67 monthly, inside the stated $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range; direct contract delivery remains separately identified.

text.title: Assumptions: USD per mature operating year. The first bar is recognized service revenue, the next four bars are signed expense movements, and the sixth bar is the closing total, not another movement. Expense allocation is illustrative; revenue, net margin, and owner net match the canonical Base Case.
